title_zh: 13号线知春路—大钟寺可达性审计基线协议
purpose: Turn a documented access concern into role-comparable, segment-level evidence without preselecting a bridge, tunnel, entrance or engineering alignment.
evidence_entry_condition: E3 begins only after an authorised Accountable owner, field safeguarding, participant notice, professional lead and data plan are recorded in a Listening Receipt.

initial_sample_frame.purpose: Baseline discovery and subgroup comparison, not population prevalence estimation.
initial_sample_frame.allocation_rule: At least two accompanied task runs per role and time band, expanded until no new barrier category appears in two consecutive runs; deviations must be explained.
initial_sample_frame.exclusion_note: Children participate only through an approved safeguarding protocol and guardian consent.

field_method: Define one origin-destination task and alternative route hypotheses from official entrances and public-realm data when available.
Use accompanied walks with participant-controlled stops; offer a paper-only route and no-device participation.
Record coarse segment, barrier category, detour distance/time, crossing count, rest opportunity, help request, night legibility and task outcome.
Take redacted issue photographs only with site/participant permission; never retain faces, voiceprints or continuous personal traces.
A field verifier revisits each candidate barrier; a professional team distinguishes maintenance, wayfinding, management and engineering issues.
Publish an alternatives matrix that includes do-nothing/maintenance/wayfinding/entrance/engineering-study options and unresolved official-data needs.

candidate_metrics.candidate_threshold: no worse than the corresponding smartphone-assisted path; final value set after baseline
material improvement must be demonstrated for each affected role; no universal number is claimed
set by issue class and authorised owner after baseline
100% of sampled roles show no safety or access worsening before expansion

stop_conditions: proposal presented as an approved engineering solution
uncertainty: Official entrances, redlines, levels, passenger flows, traffic, fire access and detailed accessibility conditions are not yet available.
